Prompt text/actual entry events corroborate supported doorway location, not hinge animation or physics acceptance for every door.

Brown structural/trim masses, cool dark panels, muted green wall/plinth and patterned sidewalk are visible. Authored frame edges add local depth/readability, but panel finish and roughness/normal detail are difficult to discriminate in these deeply shaded pixels. The sign is partly cropped at right; UI covers left. No claim of photoreal/PBR/material-scale acceptance follows from map-loaded counters.

Both labels are very close first-person views. Facade ends, full canopy/silhouette, whole upper-to-lower mass proportions and sidewalk relationship are cropped. Even south-frontage at about2.36m from public-door target is a detail view, not a full16.4m street frontage.
